subject: CobaltPay security kickoff: scope, buyers, and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@cobaltpay.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@cobaltpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: CobaltPay security kickoff: scope, buyers, and procurement timeline

Hi Eleanor & Samir,

Thanks for taking time today — good conversation. This thread is a short recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and who owns what on your side.

Recap (high level):
- Use case: in-product intelligent transaction categorization and fraud signal enrichment using Redwood hosted inference.
- Systems in scope (initial ask): CobaltPay production API + batch analytics pipeline (S3-based), and embedded web widgets.
- Key decision criteria: data isolation options, latency SLOs (95p < 150ms), and E2E cost estimates.

Who we heard as owners on your side:
- Economic buyer: Samir Gupta (CFO) — cost/contract sign-off.
- Procurement: Eleanor Brooks — procurement & PO process.
- Security lead for review: Jorge Alvarez — technical security and ops.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) We will send our security questionnaire and a short network diagram. Please have Jorge review the systems in scope and flag any additions (e.g., internal BI clusters).
2) Eleanor: can you share your procurement cadence/PO template and any standard terms that typically need redlines?
3) Samir: high-level budget window — is the FY27 Q2 commit target still accurate?
4) Schedule a 45-minute security deep-dive with your tech/security folks next week. Proposed slots attached in the calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood security questionnaire (PDF), mutual action plan (XLSX), sample network surface (PNG).

I'll follow up with a short timeline once I hear back. Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
—
Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai
From: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@cobaltpay.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@cobaltpay.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@cobaltpay.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CobaltPay security kickoff: scope, buyers, and procurement timeline

Diego — thanks for the recap and materials. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Jorge will review the questionnaire; he asked that our internal BI cluster (Airflow + Redshift) be explicitly listed if Redwood will access any batch exports. At this stage we expect only read-only S3 exports, but want it noted.
- Procurement: we usually require a signed MSA + SOW; PO issuance happens after legal sign-off. I can share our standard MSA template and expected turnaround (2–3 weeks for standard vendors).
- Budget: Samir confirms FY27 Q2 is the target but would prefer to see a contract with a predictable per-token commitment and optional reserved capacity.

Action: Jorge will provide system-level comments by EOD Thu (21 Jan). I’ll upload our MSA & PO template to the DocuSign link you include.

Eleanor Brooks
Head of Procurement, CobaltPay
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@cobaltpay.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@cobaltpay.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@cobaltpay.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: CobaltPay security kickoff: scope, buyers, and procurement timeline

Monica / Rishi / Marissa — forwarding the thread and attachments. Key asks for Redwood team:

- Monica: can your team review the questionnaire and produce a short answers packet + our recommended system boundary map. Jorge specifically called out BI (Airflow/Redshift) — please mark whether that is in-scope if they plan to export S3 feeds.
- Rishi: we should prepare a performance appendix (95p latency numbers for embedding calls at 512 tokens + expected cost delta for reserved capacity).
- Marissa: please draft a one-page onboarding plan for CS handoff (SLA, rollout milestones, and 90-day success metrics).

Timeline: Jorge will provide the systems comments by EOD Thu 21 Jan. If we can get our QA pack and appendix by Fri 22 Jan, we can aim for a security deep-dive Mon 25 Jan.

Attachments forwarded: redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf, mutual-action-plan-CobaltPay.xlsx, cobaltpay-network-surface.png

Thanks — Diego
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@cobaltpay.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@cobaltpay.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: RE: CobaltPay security kickoff: scope, buyers, and procurement timeline

Diego / team / CobaltPay — attaching our completed intake responses and an annotated systems-in-scope list. Summary highlights:

- Data flows: Redwood hosted inference will ingest end-customer transaction payloads via a signed S3 export or a customer-managed VPC connector. We treat PII-level fields as out-of-band unless explicitly provided; recommend pseudonymization on export.
- Systems in-scope (confirmed by Jorge): production API (KT-01), S3 raw export buckets (BI exports), analytics Redshift (indirect, not accessed by Redwood), and embedded widgets (client-side).
- Controls: we provide encryption-at-rest (AES-256), TLS 1.2+ in transit, per-tenant keying via customer KMS (available on Redwood Private), and SOC 2 Type II evidence (link in attachments).
- Open items for CobaltPay:
  * Confirmation whether BI exports will include full PAN/tracking fields — if yes, we will need a scoping call to define masking rules.
  * Procurement term: is a 12-month reserved capacity commitment preferred or a monthly consumption model? Pricing appendix attached.

Deliverables attached: redwood-security-questionnaire-answers.pdf, annotated-system-boundary.png, SOC2-summary.pdf

Next steps proposed:
- Security deep-dive: Mon 25 Jan, 10:00–10:45 PT (invite sent).
- Diego to circulate pricing appendix and Rishi to add perf numbers by Fri 22 Jan.

Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@cobaltpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@cobaltpay.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CobaltPay security kickoff: scope, buyers, and procurement timeline

Monica — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear answers. A couple quick confirmations from our side:

- BI exports will be S3-level CSVs that do NOT include full PANs; we will pseudonymize card fields before export.
- We prefer a 12-month reserved capacity commitment with an optional scale-burst clause. Samir will finalize budget approval pending the draft SOW and SLA.
- Procurement: Eleanor will initiate the MSA flow once we have the SOC2 summary and our standard redlines applied.

We’re good to proceed with Monday’s deep-dive. I’ll have a short internal doc ready to walk through our analytics topology.

Regards,
Jorge Alvarez
Security Architect | CobaltPay
